import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import org.agrona.concurrent.UnsafeBuffer;

import FIXP.*;

/**
 * Encodes, with Real Logic's codecs of the FIXP schema, every FIXP session
 * message with fixed values, and prints them in hexadecimal: the fixtures of
 * fix2's generated FIXP codec. Its values are those of fix2's tests.
 */
public class FixpCheck {
    static final byte[] SESSION = new byte[16];
    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            SESSION[i] = (byte) (0x10 + i);
        }
    }
    static final long TS = 1_700_000_000_123_456_789L;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        UnsafeBuffer buf = new UnsafeBuffer(new byte[4096]);
        MessageHeaderEncoder h = new MessageHeaderEncoder();

        NegotiateEncoder neg = new NegotiateEncoder();
        neg.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).timestamp(TS).clientFlow(FlowType.Idempotent)
            .putCredentials(bytes("user\0secret"), 0, 11);
        print("Negotiate", buf, neg.encodedLength());

        NegotiationResponseEncoder nr = new NegotiationResponseEncoder();
        nr.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).requestTimestamp(TS).serverFlow(FlowType.Recoverable)
            .putCredentials(new byte[0], 0, 0);
        print("NegotiationResponse", buf, nr.encodedLength());

        NegotiationRejectEncoder nj = new NegotiationRejectEncoder();
        nj.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).requestTimestamp(TS).code(NegotiationRejectCode.Credentials)
            .reason("bad credentials");
        print("NegotiationReject", buf, nj.encodedLength());

        TopicEncoder tp = new TopicEncoder();
        tp.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).flow(FlowType.Idempotent).keepaliveInterval(500)
            .putClassification(bytes("MD"), 0, 2);
        print("Topic", buf, tp.encodedLength());

        EstablishEncoder est = new EstablishEncoder();
        est.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).timestamp(TS).keepaliveInterval(1000).nextSeqNo(1)
            .putCredentials(bytes("user"), 0, 4);
        print("Establish", buf, est.encodedLength());
        est.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).timestamp(TS).keepaliveInterval(1000)
            .nextSeqNo(EstablishEncoder.nextSeqNoNullValue()).putCredentials(new byte[0], 0, 0);
        print("EstablishNoNextSeqNo", buf, est.encodedLength());

        EstablishmentAckEncoder ack = new EstablishmentAckEncoder();
        ack.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).requestTimestamp(TS).keepaliveInterval(2000).nextSeqNo(100);
        print("EstablishmentAck", buf, ack.encodedLength());
        ack.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).requestTimestamp(TS).keepaliveInterval(2000)
            .nextSeqNo(EstablishmentAckEncoder.nextSeqNoNullValue());
        print("EstablishmentAckNoNextSeqNo", buf, ack.encodedLength());

        EstablishmentRejectEncoder ej = new EstablishmentRejectEncoder();
        ej.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).requestTimestamp(TS).code(EstablishmentRejectCode.KeepaliveInterval)
            .reason("too short");
        print("EstablishmentReject", buf, ej.encodedLength());

        SequenceEncoder seq = new SequenceEncoder();
        seq.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).nextSeqNo(42);
        print("Sequence", buf, seq.encodedLength());

        ContextEncoder ctx = new ContextEncoder();
        ctx.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).nextSeqNo(7);
        print("Context", buf, ctx.encodedLength());

        UnsequencedHeartbeatEncoder hb = new UnsequencedHeartbeatEncoder();
        hb.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h);
        print("UnsequencedHeartbeat", buf, hb.encodedLength());

        RetransmitRequestEncoder rr = new RetransmitRequestEncoder();
        rr.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).timestamp(TS).fromSeqNo(10).count(5);
        print("RetransmitRequest", buf, rr.encodedLength());

        RetransmissionEncoder rt = new RetransmissionEncoder();
        rt.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).requestTimestamp(TS).nextSeqNo(10).count(5);
        print("Retransmission", buf, rt.encodedLength());

        RestransmitRejectEncoder rj = new RestransmitRejectEncoder();
        rj.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).requestTimestamp(TS).code(RetransmitRejectCode.OutOfRange)
            .reason("gone");
        print("RestransmitReject", buf, rj.encodedLength());

        TerminateEncoder te = new TerminateEncoder();
        te.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).code(TerminationCode.Finished).reason("");
        print("Terminate", buf, te.encodedLength());

        FinishedSendingEncoder fs = new FinishedSendingEncoder();
        fs.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).lastSeqNo(99);
        print("FinishedSending", buf, fs.encodedLength());
        fs.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16).lastSeqNo(FinishedSendingEncoder.lastSeqNoNullValue());
        print("FinishedSendingNoLastSeqNo", buf, fs.encodedLength());

        FinishedReceivingEncoder fr = new FinishedReceivingEncoder();
        fr.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).putSessionId(SESSION, 0, 16);
        print("FinishedReceiving", buf, fr.encodedLength());

        AppliedEncoder ap = new AppliedEncoder();
        ap.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).fromSeqNo(1).count(3);
        print("Applied", buf, ap.encodedLength());

        NotAppliedEncoder na = new NotAppliedEncoder();
        na.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).fromSeqNo(4).count(6);
        print("NotApplied", buf, na.encodedLength());

        MessageTemplateEncoder mt = new MessageTemplateEncoder();
        mt.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).encodingType(0xEB50).effectiveTime(MessageTemplateEncoder.effectiveTimeNullValue())
            .putVersion(bytes("1.0"), 0, 3).putTemplate(bytes("<xml/>"), 0, 6);
        print("MessageTemplate", buf, mt.encodedLength());
    }

    static byte[] bytes(String s) {
        return s.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
    }

    static void print(String name, UnsafeBuffer buf, int bodyLength) {
        int length = MessageHeaderEncoder.ENCODED_LENGTH + bodyLength;
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder(name).append(' ');
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            b.append(String.format("%02x", buf.getByte(i)));
        }
        System.out.println(b);
        buf.setMemory(0, buf.capacity(), (byte) 0);
    }
}
